intro: Ghana has a tropical coast, rainforest in the south and savanna in the north, with one of the world's largest reservoirs, Lake Volta.

chapters.title: Forest, savanna and lake
text: The south has beaches, lagoons and rainforest; Kakum National Park has a canopy walkway. The Akosombo Dam created Lake Volta, one of the largest human-made lakes by area. The north is drier savanna, with elephants in Mole National Park.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Ghana is warm all year, with rainy seasons in the south.

keyTerms.meaning: A lake made by a dam.
